description: This file implements a scheduler metrics handler for a wireless communication system, managing and reporting various cell and UE metrics, including resource allocations, HARQ acknowledgments, CSI reports, and latency statistics.

classes.name: null_metrics_notifier
classes.description: A notifier class that provides a null implementation, effectively disabling report generation.

classes.name: cell_metrics_handler
classes.description: Handles cell and UE metrics collection, processing, and reporting for a scheduler.

classes.name: cell_metrics_handler::ue_metric_context
classes.description: Stores and computes metrics for individual UEs within a cell.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell metrics handler for a specified cell configuration.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell metrics handler for a specified cell index.

methods.name: compute_report
methods.description: Generates a report of UE metrics, resets internal counters.
